svg.title: Compressed-air required storage matrix
svg.desc: Calculated required total storage in US gallons for ten net shortfalls and seven event durations, using a 20-psi pressure band. Cells round upward; unrounded values are retained.

g.text: Required total storage for each shortfall and event duration
Each cell: US gallons, rounded up to a whole gallon.
Worked case: 40 cfm × 30 s requires 109.9 US gal.
This is the idealized inventory requirement before design margin.
Flow reference: 1 atm, 20°C · tank: 20°C · pressure band: 20 psi

a.text: Method: DOE sourcebook, Fact Sheet 6, p. 43 · AI-assisted analysis
